title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - Maya
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal scratchpad for SOC2 readiness - collecting open Qs, initial control mapping ideas, evidence locations, and short-term action items. NOT final.

Scope: hosted API + Dedicated control plane + Private deploy (basic scope for now). Exclude billing infra for stage 0 (check with finance later).

Open questions:
- Do we include legacy on-prem connector nodes in scope? (ask @Ravi) - probably include minimal config evidence only. JIRA-SEC-1345 created.
- Encryption at rest: which KMS keys used for Dedicated vs Private? (linked GH PR above might have KMS changes)
- Multi-tenant isolation controls: need straighforward mapping to logical tenancy docs.

Control mapping (working draft, map to SOC2 CC/TC):
- Access Control (A.1): IAM provisioning + periodic review
  Evidence: IAM audit logs (cloud), access_review sheet (drive/shared_drives/security/access-reviews/2025-Q3.xlsx)
  Gap: no automated quarterly review alerting -> temp mitigation: manual checklist
  Next: add automation ticket (infra) -> owner: Ravi -> JIRA-SEC-1370

- Change Management (A.2): PR review + approved deploy windows
  Evidence: GitHub PR history + deploy playbooks (infra runbook folder)
  Gap: missing explicit emergency change log format
  Next: draft emergency changelog template (Maya) and add to runbooks

- Encryption in transit (A.3): TLS enforced on public endpoints
  Evidence: load balancer config + TLS cert rotation notes (confluence page)
  Gap: need cert rotation verification test -> add to SRE test plan

- Backup & Recovery (A.4): nightly DB snapshots, retention 90d
  Evidence: backup job configs in infra repo + restore test runbook (incomplete)
  Gap: documented restore procedure not run in last 12m
  Next: schedule restore drill w/ SRE -> tentative April

Rough evidence locations (notes):
- IAM audit logs: cloud-logging > projects/redwood-api > logs/iam_audit
- Access review spreadsheet: Drive path: shared_drives/security/access-reviews/2025-Q3.xlsx (copy of last review)
- PR history: github.com/redwood-inference/* repos (search org:infra-config label:deploy)
- Confluence: SEC/SOC2 Program page (linked above)

Action items (short):
- [ ] Confirm scope for on-prem connectors (Ravi) -> JIRA-SEC-1345 (in progress)
- [ ] Draft emergency change log template (Maya) -> due 2026-03-10
- [ ] Trigger restore drill planning meeting with SRE + infra (Elena)
- [ ] Add quarterly access review automation RFC (owner: Ravi)

Notes to self:
- Keep mapping minimal for first attestation; prioritize controls with tech debt (access, change mgmt, backups).
- Collect sample evidence files into a single evidence bucket (encrypted) - ask infra for temp access.
- When prepping auditor packet: anonymize user lists, but keep role definitions.

Loose thoughts / prompts for auditor prep call:
- We should show how smart routing + caching impacts availability SLAs (doesn’t directly affect security but ops continuity)
- Be ready to explain Dedicated vs Private differences re: KMS & network controls

Useful links / refs to copy into formal mapping: Confluence SOC2 Program, JIRA-SEC board, infra-config PRs, access review spreadsheet.

End of scratchpad (will iterate).
